metadata.conventions: positive even N; ordered prime pairs; natural logarithms; population standard deviation

step3.reference_analysis: Raw std agrees at the reference precision; normalized std and correlation do not. All 5000 ordered counts are independently verified. The stated full singular series uses every odd prime divisor, not just primes <= sqrt(N) or the first seven primes. Changing ddof from 0 to 1 multiplies std by sqrt(5000/4999), which cannot explain the discrepancy. The supplied reference computation is unavailable, so its exact cause cannot be determined; no definition or reference has been changed.

step5.reference_analysis: The reference 1.9868 is not reproduced with all odd prime divisors and the stated 100000 positive even inputs. Multiplicative sieve and independent factorization agree at every input. Finite cutoff of prime divisors would reduce the mean but would define a different function; the reference provenance is unknown. The rounding of C2 cannot explain a difference of 0.0131358.
